name: meson-ticket-bot
description: Discord bot that looks up Meson cross-chain swaps and posts the details into support tickets.

scripts.prestart: node scripts/build-index.mjs || echo index build failed - starting anyway
scripts.test: node --test --test-timeout=60000 test/bot.test.mjs test/presets.test.mjs test/no-follow.test.mjs test/bundle.test.mjs test/no-bundle.test.mjs
